output: Hypothesis: The peak of Axes & Celts occurred in the 32nd century BCE, as indicated by the highest Z values in the archaeological datasets. This hypothesis is based on the analysis of the `time_series_data.csv` and `capital.csv` datasets, where the peak values for Axes & Celts correspond to the CE value of -3200 (3200 BCE). The variables chosen are the Z values for Axes & Celts (`AxesCelts` and `ZBeil`), and the relationship between these variables and the time period (CE or BCE) indicates a peak in the 32nd century BCE. The statistical significance of this peak is supported by the consistent mapping of the peak indices to the same time period across both datasets.
